unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; topology and logical payload do not measure traffic (capability probe, both ranks: status unknown).
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: NVLink per-link counters unavailable: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 on both GPU-6c11763a and GPU-cc3c3439; links list empty.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; no successful counter probe was observed in capability evidence.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_bus_bytes: device_telemetry supplies device-wide NVML rates with native ~20 ms sampling windows that are not aligned to operator ranges, not per-collective bytes; idle probe rates (390-1562 KB/s) are not workload traffic and must not be inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_split: Nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer and no collector reports this split directly; it can only be bounded indirectly by comparing collective_calibration reference durations at the observed sizes with in-step kernel intervals and submit associations.
unavailable_fields.exact_bucket_to_kernel_binding: Exact bucket links require native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership; the parent bucket inventory reports many-to-many parameter ownership, so per-bucket cost attribution for the candidate's collectives remains ambiguous.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion of each collective may remain unknown.

rationale: Candidate 75e28d3d is accepted (communication_kernel_sum_ms 35.24 vs paired parent 52.98 and original aggregate 53.63; step_ms 113.96 <= 120.90 limit) and quality passed, so collection targets the remaining uncertainty for the frozen objective: what the candidate actually does on the wire and how much of its ~35 ms max-rank NCCL kernel sum is device waiting versus collective progress. Parent traces show the objective includes waiting (identical 28,351,488 B / 157,541,376 B f32 allreduces over SHM/direct with peer_access disabled took ~13.6 ms on rank 0 versus ~1.86 ms on rank 1), and the candidate's route label invoke:aligned-official-bucket-allreduce (count 2, versus the parent's 13 collectives) is candidate-reported telemetry with 0 framework fallbacks, not native proof. Selections: nsys (available per capability probe) for native per-collective kernel intervals, overlap and attribution of the candidate's actual collectives; execution_timeline for CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals to bound submission skew behind the balanced per-rank kernel times (clock alignment bounds apply to CPU submissions only; it never replaces a communication hook); nccl_tuning because kernel entry names such as ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL do not identify the actual algorithm/protocol/channel decisions, which are the main tunable lever on this SHM, no-P2P, no-NVLink transport; collective_calibration as a correctness-checked full-world SUM allreduce reference at the actually observed sizes/dtypes (28,351,488 B x12, 157,541,376 B x1) to contextualize in-step durations - a reference experiment, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate; candidate_diagnostics to record handled exceptions and False returns that would reveal a silent fallback path (empty events do not establish which successful path executed; the trace collectors provide that corroboration); binding_cost because the candidate is additive (retains parent bundle, direct binding, no functional replacements does not imply zero binding overhead) and its whole-invocation overhead informs the step_ms budget in subsequent candidate resource feedback. Excluded: torch (already ran and supplies communication_kernel_sum_ms), python_runtime (perturbs execution and its cProfile times are host dispatch costs, not device kernel or clean step evidence), device_telemetry (device-wide native-window NVML readings cannot attribute per-collective traffic). No per-collective PCIe/NVLink bytes, wait-versus-wire split, exact bucket binding, or GPU-readiness bounds are claimed beyond the listed unavailable fields with observed reasons; bucket identity stays ambiguous absent native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership.
